entities.summary: Kiriko Takemura , known professionally as Kyary Pamyu Pamyu, is a Japanese singer, model and tarento. Her public image is associated with Japan's kawaii and decora culture, centered in the Harajuku neighborhood of Tokyo. Kyary's music is produced by musician Yasutaka Nakata of electronic music duo Capsule. Kyary Pamyu Pamyu was a performers & entertainers from Nishitōkyō-shi (b. 1993-01-29, Nishitōkyō-shi). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
